Inline emits D1 then D0 and no D2, and moves the key function to the first non-inline virtual, InitResources -- which is why this TU now emits the class vtable and RTTI chain as compiler-only output.

The per-function shard referenced the ROM's data symbol, which config/arm9/overlays/ov026/symbols.txt records at the public address point 0x02113ae0. This TU emits its own vtable, whose _ZTV symbol addresses the vtable object eight bytes lower, so the source has to compute the same address point itself -- the measured eight-byte bias tools/objisolate.py and tools/reloc_audit.py both pin.
